p3_findings.finding: if nulavioLayout.onChanged.addListener throws (window without toolbar/closing at load), setUpLayout rejects before its first refresh and the section stays in the loading text without error or retry
p3_findings.precondition: Settings hosted in a chromeless window or one closing at that instant; recoverable by reloading the page
p3_findings.disposition: deferred to the next UX3 slice; no in-product path opens Settings in such a window today

p3_findings.finding: onChanged observers bind to the window resolved at registration; dragging the Settings tab to another window leaves observers on the old window until the next interaction, and closing the old window unsubscribes for good
p3_findings.impact: the Current-window line can be stale; radios keep working; pref observers still fire; no leak
p3_findings.disposition: deferred with the D-UX2 adoption work

p3_findings.finding: state() is not serialized with the applying queue, so another Settings window can transiently render Custom mid-transition
p3_findings.impact: self-corrects on the next notification; the applying window is guarded by its busy state
p3_findings.disposition: accepted: reporting the actual (mixed) state honestly is the intended behaviour

p3_findings.finding: tests never lock sidebar.revamp (the third observed pref), simulate a real window closing inside apply's window loop, or assert the hover attribute on a window opened after a Foco apply
p3_findings.disposition: deferred to the next UX3 slice alongside P3-1/P3-2 coverage
